# Vendored LinkedIn outreach sources

This directory contains only source material needed by the LinkedIn-only acquisition system.

## Active source packages

- package-linkedin-prospector
- package-linkedin-outreach
- linkedin-lead-exporter
- linkedin-prospecting-engine
- linkedin-client-acquisition-router
- gtm-prospecting-system/skills/* (curated LinkedIn-relevant prospecting skills)

## Deliberately excluded

Cross-channel outreach, email, phone enrichment, CRM connectors, paid lead providers, profile/content publishing systems, and the historical OpenOutreach package are not part of this runtime.

## Storage rule

Only source skill material is vendored. No SQLite database, real prospect data, browser cookies, session tokens, screenshots, reports, credentials, or runtime caches are copied into this repository.
